title: Page 7
lines: 真没想到，这世上有一个女人可以让齐藤英树执着成这样，席舞这女人是长了三头六臂吗？如今倒是后悔当初没亲自见她一见了。
“父亲，我想娶她为妻，如果她真的成了我黑木家的人，你应该就可以安心了吧？”
黑木久听闻，却半点没有安心的样子，反而蹙起眉头。“她愿意嫁你吗？她毕竟曾经是齐藤英树的女人……”
娶她进门，反成祸水，他可半点都不乐见呵。
“那都是过去的事了，父亲。”
“你确定都过去了？”黑木久冷冷地看着他。“若都过去了，他何必为了她插手这些事？”
“黑木先生。”有人在门外恭敬地喊着黑木久，是罗楠。
“有事？”
“有位齐藤先生说要见您，不知您见是不见？”
门内，黑木久看了黑木悦司一眼，道：“我得会会这个人，你刚刚说的事，我们之后再谈吧。”
“知道了。”黑木悦司很潇洒地起身离开，戴上墨镜，走出俱乐部时刚好和刚进门的齐藤英树错肩而过。
齐藤英树率先停下脚步叫住了他。“席舞想见你。”
“她果真在你那里。”黑木悦司淡淡地笑了。“她还敢见我？”
他给她的房间门卡她没用，还给他闹失踪，让他整整两天找不到人，根本就是个落跑新娘。
“她病了。”齐藤英树淡淡提了一句，不想让他误会了席舞，让席舞难做人。
黑木悦司一怔，随即出手抓住他。“严重吗？怎么病的？她那副破身子就不会小心注意一点吗？真是的……”
齐藤英树不想多解释，只说：“要见不见随你，老实说，我并不想让她见你。明天中午十二点，桃园机场见，我只让她等你五分钟。”
“机场？为什么？”
齐藤英树好笑地望着他。“你回日本的机票不是订好了？就是明天中午的飞机不是吗？”
黑木悦司错愕地看着他。连这个他都知道？这男人根本与间谍无异啊。
“我会带她去见你。”说完，齐藤英树没再理他，头也不回地走进了这间私人俱乐部。
两个高大出色的男人出现在机场，很难不引起一阵骚动，可这两个男人完全无视于众人的目光，眼底锁定的只有眼前这个女人——席舞。
今日，她穿着一袭削肩白色雪纺长洋装，腰间系了一个简单的蝴蝶结，飘逸清丽地出现在他面前。
席舞站在齐藤英树的后方，一脸愧疚地看着黑木悦司。
黑木悦司墨镜下的眼在她略微苍白的脸上淡淡扫过，那张脸虽然因为生病而有些苍白，可她的唇角微微勾起，望着齐藤英树的眼神也带着一股甜味，看起来还真是挺美的。
“你到底跟老头子说了什么？他竟然肯放过她？”黑木悦司挑眉，质问起齐藤英树这个在她身边看起来高大英俊到很碍他眼的男人。
齐藤英树扯唇一笑，上前一步靠在他耳边低问：“怎么？没藉口让你娶她，你不高兴？原来你真的想娶她？这个她知道吗？”
黑木悦司是不悦，不过他不悦的原因不是他真的想娶她没娶成恼羞成怒，而是有一个男人可以比他更能控制状况，让老头子俯首称臣。这点真是让他非常不悦！
可这男人此刻的骄傲模样更让他不悦——
黑木悦司抬眸看向他身后的席舞，不悦地眯起双眸。“你亲口跟我说，你究竟要嫁谁？”
席舞被他这一眯一瞪的，感到更愧疚了，微微躲到齐藤英树后头，他拉住她的小手，她也拉住他的，小小声地说：“如果一定要嫁，我要嫁他。”
死前唯一想念的人只有他，知道自己的心意之后，她怎能再放手？何况，他需要她……
黑木悦司板起一张英气美丽的脸。“你过来。”
闻言，齐藤英树不放手，反而把她抓得更牢。
“我过去一会儿就好。”席舞可怜兮兮地看着他，见齐藤英树一脸的冷意，声调更软。“真的就一会儿……英树，黑少对我来说像亲人一样……”
真是看不下去了……
这女人根本被齐藤英树吃得死死的吧？
黑木悦司本来想走过去直接把人给拉过来，却见齐藤英树松了手，那女人小跑步地奔了过来，这才忍住。
“你确定你要的是他？不后悔？你以为你有几条命可以陪他玩？”她一近身，他就忍不住想低咆。
这人，说话一语双关啊。
席舞幽幽地看着他。“对不起，黑少，我知道我不该再回到他身边的，我也不想，可是我没办法……我爱他，他也需要我……”
“你嫁他，我可保不了你的命，你甚至会连累他，这样你也要嫁？”反正这里没别人可以戳破他的谎言，让她以为不嫁他就不成，他就是想看看她的心意究竟是如何罢了。
她看着他。“反正我的命是你救的，你若想收回去，我也没意见。”
意思是如果他决定不帮她，让她死，那就是他故意要收回她的命了？有没有这样栽赃的啊？
“那他呢？”他不动她，但可以动齐藤英树吧？
“等你打得过他再说……”
“什么？”黑木悦司一愣。
现在，她是在看不起他吗？
“我是说……他有自保的能力。”她越说越小声。
反正，这女人就是呆就是笨就是傻！被骗了一次不够，还想被骗第二次就对了？
既然如此，他干么多管闲事？
“你说过要报恩的，现在是报恩的时候了。”他突然说。
嗄？席舞顿时感到为难万分。
“我真的不能嫁你，黑少，如果你非要我用这个报答你，那你干脆让我死了比较爽快些。”
黑木悦司咬牙。
“你以为我黑少这么没行情吗？还要逼婚才娶得到老婆？”
“我说你听！”
“好，你说。”
“在那头树面前，乖乖地让我吻上一分钟，不准抵抗。”
她古怪地看着他。“就这样？”
“就这样。”他微笑。
“这到底报了你什么恩？”真的很怪……
“男性的尊严。”还有那头树一辈子不爽的情绪。这样应该算他臝了吧？黑木悦司的脸上露出绝美的笑。
席舞挣扎着，虽说只是一个吻就可以报恩，根本就是大大便宜了她，可这个吻却是在齐藤英树面前，还是让她有点想要打退堂鼓。
黑木悦司挑高了眉。“不想？那给你另一个报恩的机会——当间谍，把齐藤家的所有情报都给我偷出来！”
“这不行啦。”
“那就主动过来吻我。”黑木悦司不悦地瞪着她。“有人报恩像你这样没诚意的吗？还挑三拣四、讨价还价？”
她似乎真的有点过分了。
席舞看了一眼不远处的齐藤英树，他也正看着她。
该避的总归是避不掉吧？
席舞低咒一声，踮起脚尖，主动吻上黑木悦司的唇——
黑木悦司微笑，反手把她紧搂入怀。
这一幕，让齐藤英树一张俊脸冻结成冰……
黑木悦司只觉眼前黑影一闪，怀中的女人瞬间被夺走，转眼已落入齐藤英树的怀里。
真是好身手呵。
黑木悦司很想吹声口哨，可惜那张俊脸太难看了，只好作罢，摆上一脸愉快笑意，挥手走人。
“记得寄喜帖给我啊，树。”嗓门不大不小，刚好落进他身后那两人的耳里。
“他叫谁呢？”树也是他叫的吗？
“总比叫那头树好。”她嘀咕了句。
齐藤英树低下头。“你说什么？”
“没什么。”她吐吐舌，不敢瞧他。“你……没想问我的话吗？”
content_en:
I really didn't expect that there is a woman in this world who can make Saito Hideki become so obsessed. Does this woman Xi Wu have three heads and six arms? Now I regret not meeting her in person.
"Father, I want to marry her. If she really becomes a member of my Kuroki family, you should be able to feel at ease, right?"
Kuroki heard this for a long time, but he didn't feel relieved at all. Instead, he frowned. "Is she willing to marry you? After all, she was once Saito Hideki's woman..."
Marrying her would turn out to be a disaster, and he wasn't happy about it at all.
"That's all in the past, Father."
"Are you sure it's all over?" Kuromu Jiu looked at him coldly. "If it's all over, why would he interfere in these things for her?"
"Father——"
"Mr. Kuroki." Someone called Kuroki Jiu respectfully outside the door. It was Luo Nan.
"Is something wrong?"
"Mr. Saito said that he wants to see you. I wonder if you want to see him or not?"
Inside the door, Kuroki glanced at Kuroki Eiji and said, "I have to meet this person. Let's talk about what you just said later."
"I got it." Kuroki Etsuji stood up and left coolly, put on his sunglasses, and when he walked out of the club, he happened to pass by Saito Hideki who had just entered.
Saito Hideki was the first to stop and call him. "Xi Wu wants to see you."
"She is indeed at your place." Kuroki Eiji smiled faintly. "She still dares to see me?"
She didn't use the room key card he gave her, and she even made him disappear so that he couldn't find anyone for two days. She was basically a runaway bride.
"She is sick." Saito Hideki said lightly, not wanting him to misunderstand Xi Wu and make it difficult for Xi Wu to be a good person.
Kuroki Eiji was startled, and then took action to catch him. "Is it serious? Why is she sick? Couldn't she be more careful with her broken body? Really..."
Saito Hideki didn't want to explain more and just said: "It's up to you whether you want to see her or not. To be honest, I don't want her to see you. I'll meet you at Taoyuan Airport at 12 noon tomorrow. I'll only ask her to wait for you for five minutes."
"Airport? Why?"
Saito Hideki looked at him funny. "Didn't you book your flight back to Japan? Your flight will be at noon tomorrow, right?"
Kuroki Eiji looked at him in astonishment. Does he even know this? This man is no different from a spy.
"I will take her to see you." After saying that, Saito Hideki ignored him and walked into the private club without looking back.
Chapter 18(2)
When two tall and outstanding men appeared at the airport, it was difficult not to cause a commotion, but these two men completely ignored everyone's gaze, and their eyes were only focused on the woman in front of them - Xi Wu.
Today, she was wearing a long white chiffon dress with sharp shoulders and a simple bow tied around her waist. She appeared in front of him elegantly and elegantly.
Xi Wu stood behind Saito Hideki and looked at Kuroki Eiji with a guilty look on his face.
Kuroki Etsuji's eyes under his sunglasses lightly scanned her slightly pale face. Although her face was a little pale due to illness, the corners of her lips were slightly raised, and her eyes looking at Saito Hideki also had a sweet taste. She looked really beautiful.
"What on earth did you say to the old man? He was actually willing to let her go?" Kuroki Eiji raised his eyebrows and asked Saito Hideki, a man who looked so tall and handsome next to her that it was an eyesore.
Saito Hideki smiled, stepped forward and leaned into his ear and whispered: "What? There is no excuse for you to marry her, are you unhappy? So you really want to marry her? Does she know this?"
Kuroki Etsuji was displeased, but the reason for his displeasure was not that he really wanted to marry her but didn't get angry because he didn't, but that there was a man who could control the situation better than him and make the old man surrender. This really made him very unhappy!
But this man's proud look at this moment made him even more displeased——
Kuroki Yuesi raised his eyes to look at Xi Wu behind him, narrowing his eyes in displeasure. "Tell me personally, who are you going to marry?"
Xi Wu felt even more guilty after being stared at by him, and hid slightly behind Saito Hideki. He held her little hand, and she held his, and said in a low voice: "If I must marry, I will marry him."
The only person she missed before she died was him. How could she let go after knowing her feelings? Besides, he needs her...
Kuroki Etsuji put on a heroic and beautiful face. "Come here."
Hearing this, Saito Hideki did not let go, but held her tighter.
"I'll just go over there in a moment." Xi Wu looked at him pitifully. Seeing the coldness on Saito Hideki's face, his tone became softer. "Really just for a while... Hideki, Master Hei is like a family member to me..."
I really can’t stand it anymore...
Is this woman completely eaten up by Hideki Saito?
Kuroki Etsuji originally wanted to go over and pull the person over, but he saw Saito Hideki let go of his hand and the woman ran over at a trot, so he held back.
"Are you sure it's him you want? Don't you regret it? How many lives do you think you have to play with him?" As soon as she got closer, he couldn't help but want to growl.
This man speaks with double entendres.
Xi Wu looked at him faintly. "I'm sorry, Mr. Hei, I know I shouldn't go back to him, and I don't want to, but I can't help it... I love him, and he needs me too..."
"If you marry him, I can't save your life. You will even harm him, so you have to marry?" Anyway, no one here can expose his lie, making her think that she can't do it if she doesn't marry him. He just wants to see what her feelings are.
She looked at him. "Anyway, you saved my life. If you want to take it back, I have no objection."
Does this mean that if he decides not to help her and lets her die, then he is deliberately taking her life back? Is there such a frame-up?
"What about him?" He couldn't move her, but he could move Saito Hideki, right?
"Wait until you can beat him..."
"What?" Kuroki Etsuji was stunned.
Now, is she looking down on him?
"I mean... he has the ability to protect himself." She became softer and softer as she spoke.
Anyway, this woman is stupid, dumb and stupid! Being deceived once is not enough, why would you want to be deceived a second time?
In this case, why is he meddling so much?
"You said you wanted to repay your kindness. Now is the time to repay your kindness." He said suddenly.
Huh? Xi Wu suddenly felt extremely embarrassed.
"I really can't marry you, Mr. Hei. If you insist on me repaying you with this, then it would be easier for you to just let me die."
Kuroki Etsuji gritted his teeth.
"Do you think I, Young Master Hei, am so worthless? I have to force a marriage to get a wife?"
"...otherwise?"
"I told you to listen!"
"Okay, you say."
"In front of that tree, be obedient and let me kiss you for one minute. No resistance is allowed."
She looked at him strangely. "That's it?"
"That's it." He smiled.
"What kind of favor have I repaid you with?" It's really weird...
"Male dignity." There is also the lifelong feeling of dissatisfaction in that tree. This should count as him being naked, right? A beautiful smile appeared on Kuroki Eiji's face.
Xi Wu struggled. Although she could repay the favor with just a kiss, it was a huge advantage to her, but this kiss was in front of Saito Hideki, which still made her want to retreat.
Kuroki Eiji raised his eyebrows. "Don't want to? Then I'll give you another chance to repay your favor - become a spy and steal all the information about the Saito family for me!"
"This won't work."
"Then come over and kiss me." Kuroki Etsuji glared at her displeased. "Is there anyone as insincere as you in repaying a favor? Still picky and haggling?"
She really seemed to be taking it a little too far.
Xi Wu glanced at Saito Hideki not far away, and he was also looking at her.
You can't avoid what you should avoid, right?
Xi Wu cursed, stood on tiptoes, and took the initiative to kiss Kuroki Yuesi's lips——
Kuroki Eiji smiled and held her tightly in his arms.
This scene made Saito Hideki's handsome face freeze into ice...
Kuroki Etsuji felt a dark shadow flash before his eyes, and the woman in his arms was snatched away in an instant, and fell into Saito Hideki's arms in the blink of an eye.
What a great skill.
Kuroki Eiji wanted to whistle, but unfortunately his handsome face was too ugly, so he had to give up, put on a cheerful smile, waved and left.
"Remember to send me a wedding invitation, Shu." His voice was neither loud nor soft, just enough to fall into the ears of the two people behind him.
"Who did he call?" Was the tree also called his name?
"It's better than calling that tree," she muttered.
Saito Hideki lowered his head. "What did you say?"
"Nothing." She stuck out her tongue, not daring to look at him. "You...didn't you think about asking me?"
